metadata.description: Captured DELETE /api/mdm/updates/deployments/{uuid} — canonical docs say 204 No Content. Confirmed by re-GET: a subsequent GET on the same uuid returns 404 (see updates_get_details fixture family for the 404 error-body shape), not a stale 200. Confirmed against 26.4.0.0: 204 returned, immediate re-GET yields 404 with errorCode 5207.
